_comment: The picker's OWN canonical proof -- boots straight from a fresh title (no fixture_save harness pre-seed; this script drives the REAL in-game picker end to end, not the QA-only shortcut). Gate -> menu (selectable_rows:4, Continue skipped, no save yet -- issue #77 bumped this from 3: 'Settings' APPENDED at the end of ROWS is always selectable) -> move down 1 lands on 'Playtest States' (debug-build-only row, sits after Continue in ROWS so this navigation is unaffected by Continue's enabled state OR by the later-appended Settings row) -> confirm opens the picker (ui_playtest_list_rendered) -> move right x3 jumps the cursor by a full PLAYTEST_PAGE_SIZE (10) each press, landing on global index 30 (page 4, row 1) -> move down x3 lands on index 33, which PLAYTEST_FIXTURE_ORDER pins to near_garden (a mid-story fixture: Act III reached, warrior 5 + helper 1, standing at the inn bed) -> confirm copies qa/fixtures/near_garden.json into the DEDICATED 'playtest' slot (Game.install_fixture_save; NEVER 'manual' -- booting a QA state must not clobber the user's own save) and loads it directly via the slot-generic Game.load_slot (game_loaded, then world_ready from Main's swap). assert_save_exists pins the slot NAME ('playtest') so a regression back to 'manual' fails here; the final assert_state trio proves the fixture's own known state actually landed in the live sim, not just that SOME load succeeded.

Re-enter by keyboard to continue the original keyboard proof below unchanged.
